notes: The two branches meet at عبيد الله (written «عبيد، الله» in the first, «عبيد الله» in the second); what follows, «خبيب بن عبد الرحمن، ... حفص، بن عاصم ... أبي هريرة», is written once after the meeting, so it is the shared tail
«حدثنا أبي» names Ibn Numayr's father by relation only: kind relation
«قالا حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد» : Zuhayr and Muhammad b. al-Muthanna are co-transmitters on one level
